description: This file contains the CommentsController class for handling HTTP requests related to comments within articles in an ASP.NET Core application. It provides endpoints for creating, fetching, and deleting comments tied to specific articles identified by slugs.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: Controller handling comment-related HTTP endpoints for articles, utilizing MediatR for dispatching commands and queries.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new comment on a specific article identified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve comments for a specific article.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a comment by ID from a specific article.
